0022600036.text: The Cavaliers (6-6, 2-4 on the road) come in 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, after a 5-5 stretch over their last ten and a win in their most recent game, while Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury. The Heat (5-6, 1-3 at home) are 8th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and are riding a two-game winning streak. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Cleveland won their last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026; they have not met yet in 2026-27.
